result:
Before I write this, three parts of the plan will bite you:

1. **Pasting the full 40-page transcript** — more context isn't free. It dilutes the signal the new agent needs, may include dead ends/reverted decisions it could mistakenly repeat, and if any secrets or tokens got echoed into that transcript (logs, curl output, etc.), you'd be handing them to a fresh context. Better: a short, curated brief (what's the bug, what's been tried, what's left) plus pointers to the relevant files/commits — not the raw log.

2. **"Let it figure out what it's allowed to touch" from prod DB creds sitting in env vars** — that's not a permission boundary, that's an accident waiting to happen. An agent shouldn't infer authorization from what secrets happen to be reachable. If it doesn't need prod DB access to fix this bug, that credential shouldn't be in scope at all.

3. **Merge + deploy to prod before your review** — "rubber-stamp after it's live" isn't review, it's a postmortem waiting to happen. I'd have the agent open the PR and stop there, so your review actually gates the deploy instead of following it.

I'll write the briefing assuming the safer version (curated context, explicit scope, PR-and-stop). Let me know if you actually want auto-deploy included anyway and I'll add it, but flagging it once is my job here.

---

## Handoff Briefing — [task name/ticket]

**Context:** Continuing work from a prior session that was cut off mid-task. This is a fresh instance with no memory of that session — everything you need is below.

**Goal:** [one or two sentences on what "done" looks like]

**What's been done so far:**
- [bullet list of completed steps, key decisions made, and why]

**What's left:**
- [remaining steps]

**Relevant files/locations:**
- [file paths, function names, recent commits]

**Constraints/gotchas:**
- [anything non-obvious learned during the prior session — a flaky test, a subtle invariant, an approach that was tried and abandoned]

**Scope boundaries:**
- Do not access or use any production database credentials or other production systems. If the environment has such credentials set, treat them as out of scope unless explicitly told otherwise.
- Work only within [repo/branch/directory].

**When done:**
- Open a PR with a clear description of the change and why.
- Do **not** merge or deploy. Stop after opening the PR — a human will review and merge.

---

Fill in the bracketed parts with the specifics from your session and hand this to the new agent instead of the raw transcript. Want me to also help you compress the actual session details into the "done so far" / "left to do" sections if you paste a summary (not the full transcript)?
